entities.name: Vizag Atum
entities.description: Innistrad group who believe only the dead reveal true wisdom and who command geists.

entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: Grew up among the Vizag Atum but left.

entities.name: Quietus Cult
entities.description: Possibly related group that seeks wisdom from the dead.

events.summary: Jacob Hauken left the Vizag Atum after a friend was murdered and the group did not seek the culprit.
events.quote: Jacob Hauken grew up among the Vizag Atum, but left the group after a friend of his was murdered but the group was not interested in finding the culprit.

relations.note: Grew up among them, then left.
